PROGRESS retreat on Nov 23-25, 2011

Stefan Buschmann and Matthias Trapp, members of our Computer Graphics Systems group at the HPI, will join and contribute to a three-day retreat of the joint PROGRESS project. The meeting will take place between Nov 23 and Nov 25 in Bad Belzig.

PROGRESS page: www.hpi.uni-potsdam.de/doellner/projects/progress.html
